run_adsorbml: run the AdsorbML pipeline for a given slab and adsorbate using a pretrained ML model
adsorb_ml_pipeline: run an ML-based pipeline that relaxes slabs, generates adsorbate-slab configurations, and validates anomalies
ocp_adslab_generator: generate multiple adsorbate-slab configurations from a slab structure and list of adsorbates
detect_anomaly: detect anomalies like adsorbate dissociation, desorption, surface changes, or intercalation between initial and final atomic structures
reference_adslab_energies: reference adsorbate-slab energies to atomic and slab reference energies to compute adsorption energy
